title: Beyond Confidence: Rethinking Uncertainty Calibration in Deep Code Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.21248v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning models have shown significant promise in code-related tasks. While confidence calibration techniques have been proposed to improve model reliability, their effectiveness in real-world tasks with strict accuracy requirements remains uncertain. In this paper, we investigate two key questions: first, whether existing measurement metrics, including confidence scores and uncertainty metrics, are effective for guiding selective prediction; and second, whether existing calibration techniques can improve these metrics to better identify cases where model predictions are likely to succeed or fail. translated_title: 超越置信度：重新思考深度代码模型中的不确定性校准
translated_abstract: 深度学习模型在代码相关任务中已展现出显著潜力。尽管已有置信度校准技术被提出以提升模型可靠性，但其在具有严格准确性要求的真实任务中的有效性仍不确定。本文研究了两个关键问题：第一，现有的度量指标（包括置信度分数和不确定性指标）能否有效指导选择性预测；第二，现有的校准技术能否改进这些指标，以更好地识别模型预测可能成功或失败的情形。我们使用七个代码模型在缺陷预测和漏洞检测任务上开展了系统性研究，评估了十三种不确定性信号和三种广泛使用的事后校准方法。我们的分析揭示了三个主要发现：（1）即使是不确定性信号表现强劲，其校准程度仍可能不佳，并在阈值处提供有限的区分能力……（原文摘要截断于此）
tldr: 本文通过对七个代码模型在缺陷预测与漏洞检测任务上的系统评估，发现现有不确定性信号即使区分能力较强也可能校准不佳，且常用事后校准方法难以有效提升识别模型预测成败的能力。
en_tdlr: Through a systematic study of seven code models on defect prediction and vulnerability detection, this paper shows that even strong uncertainty signals can remain poorly calibrated, and widely used post-hoc calibration methods provide limited improvement in identifying when model predictions succeed or fail.
